title: 9 AL/BC patterns: document distribution, price calculation & barcode extensibility
summary: Nine new AL/BC patterns document best practices for document distribution, report selections, price calculation extensibility, barcode usage, and posting-cascade field mirroring, with verified examples from Business Central source.
key_points: Adds nine knowledge articles, each with bad and good AL examples
Covers document distribution: Report Selections usage, Print and Email actions, and Find Entries (Navigate) extensions
Covers pricing extensibility: price calculation handlers, price source types and custom price sources
Covers TransferFields field mirroring in posting cascades and barcode generation through the Barcode module
Updates the data-modeling review skill so these topics are in scope, and adds evaluation fixtures
quote: Nine rules about Business Central's document distribution architecture and posting-cascade/pricing extensibility, verified against BCApps source and Microsoft Learn
